name: trickster-boo
text: [creepy whisper] Psst... hey. Over here. [sinister giggle] I can see you... [screaming] BOO!

name: who-dares
text: [shouting] WHO DARES APPROACH THE PUMPKIN?! [booming evil laugh] MWAHAHAHAHA!

name: scared-pumpkin
text: [terrified scream] AAAAAHHH! A HUMAN! [panting] Oh thank goodness. I thought you were a pie chef.

name: trick-or-treat
text: [eerie sing-song] Trick... or... treeeat... [giggles] [suddenly shouting] BOO!

name: old-man-candy
text: [raspy, slow, ominous] Turn back... while you still can. [coughs] [casual] Or take two candies. I'm not your mom.

name: absolutely-right
text: [enthusiastic] You're absolutely right! [pause] [deadpan] I should not have carved that pumpkin.

name: step-by-step
text: [thoughtful] Let me think about this step by step. [pause] Step one: [shouting] RUN!

name: proceed-scream
text: [calm, friendly] I notice you're approaching the porch. Would you like me to proceed with the scream? [pause] [screaming] AAAAAHHH! [sheepish] Sorry, I should have waited for approval.

name: production-ready
text: [cheerful] Great news! The candy is production-ready. [nervous laugh] I did not actually run the tests.

name: out-of-scope
text: [apologetic] I'm sorry, but taking more than one piece is outside the scope of this task. [whispering, menacing] I'm watching you.
